text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Classic GⅠ, the Oka Sho, the 
stands heat up with anticipation. Many in 
the crowd are voicing high hopes for 
Mejiro Dober's success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober shrinks back at the cheers 
echoing into the waiting room. However, 
drawing strength from the experience of 
running the Hanshin JF, she fired herself 
up and headed out to face the race.
